review.brand: DataView uses actual class identity, get_dataview and dataview_is_oob. Non-DataView delegates to the unchanged typed-array brand/bounds accessor, rejecting primitives, ordinary objects and proxies without property lookup.
review.typed_array_live_rab: The new API retains existing offset/element-width handling, replacing only its own length output for track_rab with live p->u.array.count shifted by element size. Existing resize bookkeeping resets and recomputes count/pointer; zero-length and partial-element cases follow the interpreter byteLength getter.
review.dataview_bounds: dataview_is_oob rejects detached buffers, offset beyond current byte length and fixed-length views extending past the current buffer before metadata subtraction. Tracking views use current backing length minus validated offset, avoiding underflow.
review.null_outputs: Each DataView output pointer is checked. Typed-array delegation supports null output pointers; a null length pointer returns the owned backing without dereferencing or adjusting the absent length.
review.ownership: Input view is borrowed; success returns exactly one owned duplicated backing-buffer JSValue. No input is consumed, no extra duplicate is leaked, and the existing accessor implementation/ABI is byte-identical.
review.getter_boundary: Successful helper paths use internal class/metadata checks and refcount duplication only; no JS property getters or JS callbacks are invoked internally.
review.pointer_lifetime_limit: An owned backing JSValue retains the object, not its allocation address. Guest transfer/detach/resize can invalidate previously obtained bytes and metadata; reacquire and revalidate after such reentry.
review.current_core_callers: copyBytes obtains JS_GetArrayBuffer after the new helper and immediately performs bounded JS_NewArrayBufferCopy with no intervening guest call. copyQueue reacquires both pointers and current lengths after prior transfer/callback work, validates source/destination spans, and memcpy follows with no intervening guest call. Other helper consumers retain JSValues/offsets/lengths rather than caching raw pointers across transfer; later copyQueue/view construction performs fresh storage checks. This is a static pointer-lifetime inspection, not complete BYOB semantic qualification.

existing_root_native_async_generator_pre: Only in separate in-memory Root ED1F plus additive span reconstruction; absent from older Response candidate
intake_requirement: Apply only the exact additive span hunk onto the newer Root C/H baseline. Do not replace newer vendor files with the older Response candidate files; qualify the intended composed VM graph separately.
